findings.text: D1: Anubis Chain block explorer confirmed at browser.anubispace.org (Blockscout-powered). No name-tag search API equivalent to etherscan.io/searchHandler exists for this explorer; address-specific fetches via the Blockscout instance were not available because no specific contract URL appeared in prior search results that could be re-fetched. Chain ID 6714 is not among the 13 chains supported by the DeFiPunkd read API. Zero addresses surfaced.

D2: protocol.website (https://swap.deepsea.monster/swap) was fetched and returned only a minimal meta-description confirming 'Uniswap V2 style decentralized exchange' with title 'RocketSwap'. No deployed-contracts page or address list was linked from the site. rocketswap.org was also fetched and confirmed as an official domain but contained no contract addresses or deployment docs. No deployed_contracts_doc URL could be established.

D3: protocol.audit_links is empty (none recorded). No audit PDFs or reports were surfaced from any fetched page. DEXTools tutorial article confirmed RocketSwap is described as a Uniswap V2 style AMM with shielded LP positions but cited no audit. No in-scope addresses from audits available.

D4: protocol.github is empty (none recorded). anubischain.ai links to https://github.com/anubis-chain (chain-level code, not RocketSwap DEX). No Foundry broadcast files, hardhat-deploy artifacts, or deployment indexes were found for RocketSwap. The GitHub repo for the chain itself was not fetched this run due to remaining fetch budget constraints; no RocketSwap-specific repo was discovered.

D5: protocol.chains is a single chain 'Anubis'. Chain ID confirmed as 6714 from DEXTools tutorial and anubischain.ai. No multi-chain deployment to assess. Single-chain enumeration attempted but yielded zero contract addresses.

D6: No factory addresses were surfaced in D1–D4, so factory-child enumeration was not attempted. Anubis Chain is not in the DeFiPunkd read API supported chain list, so /api/contract/read calls are not possible.
D7: No addresses were catalogued, so no role taxonomy entries could be produced.

D8: No addresses discovered from fetched URLs; nothing to place in admin_addresses[]. All corpora checked: protocol website, rocketswap.org, CoinMarketCap exchange page, DEXTools tutorials (2 articles), anubischain.ai, Blockscout explorer homepage. None contained explicit contract addresses for RocketSwap.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked 6 distinct fetched sources (protocol website, rocketswap.org, anubischain.ai, CoinMarketCap, DEXTools tutorials x2, Blockscout explorer homepage) and 2 web searches. Zero contract addresses were surfaced. The Anubis Chain (ID 6714) is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API, and no deployment documentation or GitHub repo for RocketSwap was found. Address discovery requires either a direct Blockscout API call to browser.anubispace.org or a RocketSwap-specific GitHub repo, neither of which was available this run.

protocol_metadata.about: RocketSwap is the native decentralized exchange on Anubis Chain (chain ID 6714), a selective-privacy EVM-compatible Layer 1 that launched on April 7, 2026. It operates as a Uniswap V2-style AMM, allowing users to swap tokens and provide liquidity with automated market making. RocketSwap has direct access to the chain's threshold-encrypted mempool, making it natively MEV-resistant, and supports shielded LP positions through the chain's PLONK ZK-proof precompiles. The deepest pool at launch was the DAI/LGNS pair from the AWAKE genesis project, seeded with $163 million in liquidity via the Capybara Launchpad ILO.
